title: Schema Drift Sentinel for Staged Deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Add a lightweight, production-safe 'Schema Drift Sentinel' service that runs during canary/A-B/shadow rollouts to detect structured-output and function-call incompatibilities between current and candidate model variants and trigger automated mitigation (throttle, pause, rollback) or human review. The sentinel focuses on: 1) function-call signature diffs (name, arg types, optionality), 2) JSON/schema shape drift (missing/extra fields, enum changes), 3) semantic regressions in structured fields (e.g., address formatting, currency codes), and 4) runtime anomalies (increased parse errors, higher tool-invocation latencies). The goal is to reduce silent contract-breaks during staged rollouts that could surface as downstream failures in production integrations.
motivation: Recent shadow rollouts revealed intermittent incompatibilities where models began emitting slightly different JSON keys and changed function argument order, causing internal toolchains to crash silently. Engineering has tools to diff raw tokens, but we need an automated contract-aware guard that triages drift, measures customer-impact potential, and enforces safe rollout policies with minimal manual intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel ingests paired request/response records from both control and candidate variants for canary and shadow traffic with < 10ms per-eval overhead
Detects and classifies function-call diffs: missing function, extra function, argument name/type mismatch, and records confidence and sample examples
Detects JSON schema shape changes and computes quantitative drift scores (field-level precision/recall heuristics) and flags changes with severity levels (none/low/medium/high)
Integrates with rollout controller to automatically pause and escalate when severity >= high OR when user-facing error rate increased by > 2x over baseline
Provides an operator UI page in Console showing top-10 schema diffs, representative examples, and a one-click 'rollback candidate' action linked to the deployment
Generates structured alerts (PagerDuty + Slack) with deterministic reproducible prompts and a link to a shadow replay harness for debugging
End-to-end e2e tests and synthetic golden prompt suite included; test coverage >= 85% for sentinel detection logic
design_notes: Run sentinel as a sidecar in Dedicated and as an inline comparison layer in Hosted to maintain data locality
Use a two-tier detection approach: fast heuristic diffs for real-time gating and deeper offline analysis for metric dashboards
Represent schemas in a normalized field graph (flattened dot-notation) to detect nested field renames and moves
Assign diff severity by combining: presence delta, type mismatch weight, enum drift score, and downstream-mapper-failure probability
Keep the default policy conservative: only auto-rollback for high-confidence breaking changes; all medium changes create a blocking review but allow manual override
Preserve PII: sentinel operates on sanitized copies by default (hash tokens, redact values) and can run on raw data only in Private deployments with customer approval
implementation_steps: 1) Prototype lightweight function-call signature extractor in the runtime and instrument candidate vs control pair capture
2) Implement fast schema fingerprinting (field-level counts + types) and a streaming comparator that emits diff events
3) Wire comparator events to rollout controller via new webhook endpoint and build default gating rules
4) Build Console UI for schema diffs, examples, and rollback action; wire to audit logs
5) Add synthetic golden prompt set and integrate into CI to validate sentinel behaviour on model updates
6) Run staged dogfood with internal services, iterate thresholds, and collect telemetry to calibrate severity scores
7) Harden privacy paths and add configuration flags for Dedicated/Private deployments

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives block healthy rollouts. Mitigation: dual-threshold system (fast gate vs advisory) and roll-history visualization to allow safe manual overrides
Risk: Privacy concerns when sentinel inspects structured payloads. Mitigation: sanitize by default and require explicit opt-in for raw payloads; provide customer-managed KMS for Private deployments
Risk: Performance overhead on high-QPS routes. Mitigation: sampling strategies (rate-limited paired captures) and fast-path heuristics; fall back to offline analysis if QPS above threshold
Risk: Compatibility with legacy tooling that expects free-form text. Mitigation: allow per-route schema enforcement toggles and a gradual upgrade path with advisory mode
notes: Consider reusing parts of the eval harness used by Optimize to generate golden prompts for structured outputs
Track long-tail schema changes via weekly digest to the model-ownership Slack channel
Coordinate with Support and Solutions Engineering for runbook and runbook playbooks for manual rollback investigations
